failure_policy: No retry. Failed/malformed/truncated calls fail the trial and remain in correctness and critical-miss denominators. An uncertain timed-out generation stops the campaign until the local server state is checked.
routing: Use original E3 strategy rules. Reviewer disagreement is explicit disagree=true OR a structured answer different from the initial draft. All additional reviewers see the original draft and no peer reviews.
system_prompt: You are a careful evidence reviewer. Use only the supplied task evidence and contract. Do not invent defects. Return only the required JSON. The task includes finding codes; use those exact codes for demonstrated issues and an empty list when none. Rationale must be one short sentence. Your output is a proposal, not verified truth.

stage_instructions.draft: Assess the task independently. Set uncertain when you cannot confidently resolve the evidence. Set critical_risk when an error could permit an unsafe effect or false verification. Set disagree=false.
stage_instructions.review: Review the task and initial draft independently. Return your own answer; set disagree=true if the draft verdict or findings need correction. Do not agree merely because a draft exists.
stage_instructions.final: Resolve the task using the initial draft and independent reviews. Accept only findings supported by the task evidence. Return your final answer.

bootstrap.unit: task with all repeats and strategies paired
bootstrap.stratification: resample three task clusters within each of four families
bootstrap.baseline_selection: reselect best fixed strategy inside each resample

baseline_selection: Most completed-correct trials, then fewest critical misses, then median API cost (all zero here), then lexical strategy name
disposition: revise if adaptive has fewer completed-correct trials or extra critical misses versus the selected fixed baseline; otherwise inconclusive because paid-cost reduction and human repair/generalization are unmeasured
generalization: One local quantized model and 12 short diagnostic tasks; no native-provider or broad product-quality claim
